info.name: SCS Manager Integration
info.summary: Nextcloud integration for SCS Manager (Team Folders, project ACLs, activity feeds)
info.description:
Bridges the SCS Manager with Nextcloud Team Folders (Group Folders): register project folders with a stable machine name and editable display label, sync group ACLs, and expose a per-user OCS API for listing folders and reading activity inside them.
Managed by SCS Manager. Users keep normal access to files inside project folders; renaming or deleting registrations is not offered in the Files UI.
info.author: SODa SCS
